name: Pad Lights
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Pads as a light show, beat pulse, phrase countdown or FLOW lights; VJ pads fire FLOW VJ Looks from the deck.
description: VJ pads (off by default): HOT CUE + BEAT JUMP together turns that side's pads into FLOW VJ Looks 1-8 (SHIFT + pad = light hits); any pad-mode button alone gives them back, and the deck never sees VJ presses. Idle show (default): pads glow in a colour wave on a side whose deck is stopped. Beat pulse: the playing side pulses in the track's key colour. Phrase countdown: pads fill over 32 beats, last bar red. FLOW lights: pads mirror FLOW's rig. Off returns every pad to normal.
